title: Snapdrop
descript: Snapdrop is a local file transfer tool in the browser: devices on the same network see each other and can send files or text with a click, like AirDrop. This package runs the LinuxServer Docker Hub image as a non-root container with nginx serving the client and a small node signalling server behind it.
important: Open http://<NAS-IP>:8117/ on two devices in the same LAN and send a file. All transfers are peer-to-peer in the browser; the server only does signalling. The container runs as uid 1000. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Plain HTTP on the LAN (WebRTC still works; some browsers require HTTPS for advanced features).

github.description: A self-hosted habit tracking app without "Goals"

zh-cn.descript: 习惯打卡与连续天数统计，界面简洁。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/beaverhabitsdocker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。
